title: OOUndeadExpansion
description: Undead mobs expansion for the upcoming modpack Ominous Odyssey.
body:
# OOUndeadExpansion
OOUndeadExpansion turns the animal life of your world into part of the undead threat.

Zombies and zombie animals can infect supported animals, creating hostile undead variants with their own behavior, visuals, and configurable stats. Infected animals use vanilla friendly yet deadly abilities and can easily become a formidable source of danger in the world. With the right items, they can also be cured back into living animals.

The mod was commissioned for the Ominous Odyssey modpack and is built for hostile survival gameplay, horror-leaning packs, and worlds where infection should feel like an active part of the ecosystem.

![OOUndeadExpansion.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/206c1801c20a8bad839a531fe59ca40f9444ef92.png)

## Features:
- Hostile zombie variants for many vanilla animals.
- Infection when supported animals are killed by zombies or zombie animals.
- Curing with Weakness effect and a Golden Apple.
- Configurable stats, loot, natural spawning, biome lists, and group sizes.
- Zombie animal reinforcements and help calls.
- Villager avoidance and zombie villager conversion support.

## Mobs:

### Vanilla-Based
- Zombie Chicken
- Zombie Cow
- Zombie Pig
- Zombie Sheep
- Zombie Wolf
- Zombie Ocelot
- Zombie Llama
- Frozen Polar Bear
- Zombie Horse - replaces vanilla zombie horse. Updated model and texture not included.

### Compatibility Mobs
- Zombie Panda - requires Future MC.
- Drowned Turtle - requires Oceanic Expanse.
- Drowned Dolphin - requires Oceanic Expanse.
- Glow Squid - replaces Oceanic Expanse glow squid when Oceanic Expanse is installed.

## Infection And Curing:
Infection is the main threat loop: animals killed by zombies or zombie animals can come back as hostile undead variants.

Animals can also be cured using Weakness effect and a Golden Apple, similar to vanilla zombie villagers, with unique animal data restored where supported.

![Bob.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/549f05be3db599df849287d8a2259bff9dda59b4_0.webp)

## Compatibility:

### Required
- Minecraft 1.12.2
- Minecraft Forge 14.23.5.2847 or newer
- MixinBooter
### Optional
- Future MC - enables zombie panda support.
- Oceanic Expanse - enables drowned dolphins, drowned turtles, hostile glow squid replacement, OE sounds, OE loot fallback, and OE mob conversions.
Optional compatibility content is only enabled when the related mod is installed.

## Configuration:
The mod includes configuration for natural spawning, mob stats, loot, biome lists, group sizes, and several mob-specific behaviors.

Examples include:

- Llama spit behavior.
- Pig death cloud behavior.
- Wolf healing.
- Ocelot spawn effects.
- Polar bear effects.
- Dolphin's Grace support.
- Aquatic spawn heights.
